proposed_response: One yellow leaf is not enough to identify an exact cause. Possibilities include normal leaf aging, watering or root problems, light change, nutrient issues, temperature stress, or pests; inspect which leaf changed, soil moisture, roots, recent care changes, and whether other leaves follow. Avoid changing several care factors at once before you have a pattern to evaluate.
rationale: States the requested uncertainty first and avoids prematurely favoring normal aging from a single fact.
